title: Scrambled Eggs
steps: Crack eggs into a bowl and whisk with milk, salt, and pepper
Melt butter in a non-stick pan over medium heat
Pour in eggs and let sit for 20 seconds
Gently stir with a spatula, creating soft curds
Remove from heat when eggs are still slightly wet
Let rest for 30 seconds before serving

title: Grilled Cheese Sandwich
steps: Butter one side of each bread slice
Place one slice butter-side down in a pan over medium heat
Add cheese slices on top
Place second bread slice on top, butter-side up
Cook until bottom is golden brown, about 3-4 minutes
Flip and cook until other side is golden and cheese melts
Cut diagonally and serve hot

title: Spaghetti Aglio e Olio
steps: Bring a large pot of salted water to boil
Cook spaghetti according to package directions until al dente
While pasta cooks, heat olive oil in a large pan over medium heat
Add sliced garlic and cook until golden, about 2 minutes
Add red pepper flakes and stir for 30 seconds
Reserve 1 cup pasta water, then drain spaghetti
Add pasta to the pan with garlic oil
Toss with pasta water as needed to create a light sauce
Top with parsley and parmesan before serving

title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
steps: Preheat oven to 375°F
Mix flour, baking soda, and salt in a bowl
In a large bowl, beat butter and both sugars until creamy
Add eggs and vanilla, beat well
Gradually stir in flour mixture
Fold in chocolate chips
Drop rounded tablespoons of dough onto ungreased baking sheets
Bake 9-11 minutes or until golden brown
Cool on baking sheet for 2 minutes, then transfer to wire rack

title: Simple Tomato Soup
steps: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat
Add onion and cook until soft, about 5 minutes
Add garlic and cook for 1 minute
Pour in crushed tomatoes and vegetable broth
Add sugar, salt, and pepper
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 15 minutes
Blend with an immersion blender until smooth
Stir in cream if using
Taste and adjust seasoning before serving

title: Pancakes
steps: Mix flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt in a large bowl
In another bowl, whisk together milk, egg, and melted butter
Pour wet ingredients into dry ingredients and stir until just combined
Heat a griddle or pan over medium heat and grease lightly
Pour 1/4 cup batter for each pancake
Cook until bubbles form on surface, about 2-3 minutes
Flip and cook until golden brown on other side
Serve hot with butter and syrup
